title: Norwegian Pork Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish inspired by Norwegian cuisine. This gluten-free meal is perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the skillet oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the pork is cooked through and the potatoes are tender, about 15-20 minutes.
